scheme_name: Merit Based Scholarship Scheme for Dhangar Students
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Dhangar community
Applicant must be among the top 5 rank holders in SSC or HSSC examinations
Applicant must achieve the minimum qualifying percentage as per the benefit slabs
benefits_summary: Financial awards ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹20,000 based on rank and exam percentage, disbursed via electronic bank transfer.
